ios.desc:
Sink: Your Personal Tracker for Everything

Introducing Sink, a simple yet powerful counter and tracking solution that fits seamlessly into your daily life. Track, tally, analyze, and sync your habits, events, and anything else you can think of. Fully integrated with Siri, Shortcuts, and Google Sheets, Sink is your all-in-one tracker. Effortlessly manage your productivity and gain insights into your personal growth.

Key Features:

- Track Literally Anything: From miles run to cups of coffee consumed, Sink is your go-to hub for monitoring any aspect of your life.
- Siri & Shortcuts Integration: Track without opening the app! Create and access your trackers with simple Siri commands or through Deep Integration with Shortcuts.
- Export to CSV or JSON: Want to dive deeper into analysis? Export your data to CSV or JSON and explore your trends.
- Enhance Your Habit Tracking experiences using our AI integration with SinkGPT to unlock deep insights from your data.
- Apple Watch Compatibility: Track your events from your Apple Watch using Siri. It's tracking made easy, right on your wrist.
- Complete Privacy Control: Your data is only stored locally and never sent to Sink, ensuring complete privacy.
- iCloud Backup & Restore: Safeguard your data with convenient iCloud Backup and Restore functionalities.
- Real-time Google Sheets Sync: Seamless synchronization with Google Sheets allows you to manage your data anywhere, anytime.
- Rich Insights: Streaks and time comparisons. Enjoy basic insights and key highlights, all built into the app, helping you understand your habits and behaviors.
- Event Customization: Add numeric values like minutes, miles, calories and even freeform notes to your events for nuanced tracking.
- Search Functionality: Easily search and access any part of your data.

Sink Your Habits Into Success

With its clean and intuitive interface, Sink transforms the way you perceive tracking. Designed to work with your Apple ecosystem, it becomes an essential tool for anyone aiming to understand and improve their daily routines.

Some Applications for Sink:

- Habit monitoring
- Goal setting and achievement
- Health and fitness tracking
- Expense and budget management
- Study and work performance analysis

Join the Sink Community

Download Sink today and embark on a journey toward a more organized, insightful, and empowered lifestyle. Sink is more than an app; it's a platform for growth.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Sink – Voice-Enabled Lifelogger for Effortless Data Tracking

quotes.text:
Hello HN,

I'm excited to introduce Sink, a voice-enabled lifelogger designed for effortless data tracking. With Sink, you can easily collect and sync data about virtually any event or metric in your life, all through simple voice commands or Shortcuts (or by tapping a button, of course).

Key Features:

- Voice-Activated Tracking: Use Siri to log data without opening the app.

- Real-Time Google Sheets Sync: For those who prefer desktop analysis, automagically sync to a Google Sheet in your Google Drive.

- Data Export: CSV and JSON formats supported for additional flexibility.

- Complete Privacy: Your data is only stored locally unless you choose to sync.

Why Sink?

As two software engineers with a keen interest in data and personal growth,, we felt that existing solutions didn't offer the level of ease and customization we were looking for. Sink aims to fill that gap, especially for those who are interested in quantified self but find data collection to be a hurdle.

Key Goals:

- Ensuring seamless Siri integration was a major focus, as was creating a robust syncing mechanism for Google Sheets.

- Data privacy was another concern, leading us to a local-first approach to data storage.

What's Next:

- We're looking into Android support and exploring potential API integrations for even more seamless data collection.

We'd love for you to try Sink and share your feedback. Download it here:

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sink-lifelogging-analytics/id6448770654
